title: Mono Basin terrain: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM manifest, mosaic, crop and 16-bit World Partition heightmap tiles
phase: Phase 5 - Mono Basin corridor (moved ahead by ADR 0006)
forbidden_dependencies: Committing raw or derived rasters to git
acceptance_criteria: DONE: CONFIG: world box, source project, output spacing and landscape layout live in tools/world/terrain_config.json; scripts hold no coordinates.

DONE: Z SCALE: heightmap_math.py maps metres to uint16 with world_z_cm = actor_z + (count - 32768) * ScaleZ / 128, picks ScaleZ = span * 100 / 512 (rounded up) and the actor offset at the span centre; unit tests check the formula, round trip error <= half a step, clamping, monotonicity.
DONE: GRID: component_grid() gives the landscape component count and heightmap size; nodata fill is ring-by-ring from valid neighbours with a tested error bound.
DONE: python -m unittest discover -s tools/world/tests -t tools/world passes with synthetic data only (no network, no real rasters).

PENDING DIRECTOR APPROVAL (download 3.5 GB, install rasterio): fetch_dem.py queries the TNM API for the box, writes a manifest (title, URL, size, publication date) to data/manifests/, downloads only the chosen project's tiles into data/raw/ with resume and a SHA-256 per file recorded in the manifest; re-running skips verified files.

PENDING: build_heightmap.py mosaics the tiles, crops to the box in UTM 11N, resamples to the configured spacing, fills nodata (and reports how many cells), measures the real min and max elevation, and writes 16-bit PNG tiles sized to whole landscape components plus a JSON sidecar (origin, spacing, ScaleZ, Z offset, min, max).

PENDING: real run: elevations read back from the tiles at Tioga Pass summit, the Mono Lake surface and Lee Vining town centre match the source DEM within one vertical step; report cell counts, min and max elevation and wall time.
